scope: Generic canonical pivotal construction; no concrete category.

steps.source_locator: EGNO equations (8.30) and (8.35), printed pages 214 and 217

source_locators: EGNO calls (8.30) a natural transformation, printed page 214
formal_proof_route: Braiding swaps the chosen exact pairing, making X a right dual of X*.
Uniqueness of right duals gives the objectwise inverse.
Braiding naturality plus evaluation and coevaluation mate identities prove naturality.
NatIso.ofComponents derives inverse naturality from objectwise isomorphisms.

steps.source_locator: EGNO Proposition 8.9.3 and equation (8.31), printed pages 214-215
formal_proof_route: The composite mopFunctor followed by unmopFunctor has positive double braiding as its tensorator.
Mathlib monoidal composition supplies the tensorator coherence laws.
Transport across the Drinfeld natural isomorphism constructs a coherent monoidal structure on the right double-dual functor.
This roadmap adopts EGNO equation (8.31) as the characterization of the standard double-dual tensorator.
The transported tensorator makes the Drinfeld monoidal defect exactly positive monodromy.
The balancing law cancels that monodromy and proves theta_X followed by u_X is monoidal.

steps.source_locator: EGNO Proposition 8.10.12 and equation (8.41), printed page 220
formal_proof_route: Dual uniqueness proves that the Drinfeld comparison preserves evaluation and coevaluation.
The canonical pivotal dimension reduces to the explicit ribbon loop in equation (8.41).
Braiding naturality cancels the inverse crossing from the swapped coevaluation against the positive crossing in the dual loop.
The evaluation mate law moves theta_(X*) across the cap.
The ribbon dual law identifies its mate with theta_(X**), and twist naturality moves that twist through the Drinfeld comparison.
The resulting ribbon loop for X* equals the ribbon loop for X, proving dim(X)=dim(X*).
steps.scope_note: The Lean proof establishes the ribbon-to-spherical direction directly for braided right-rigid categories. It does not use semisimplicity or prove the converse direction.

step_3_guards: mirror monodromy cannot replace positive monodromy
the ordinary identity tensorator cannot silently replace the monodromy tensorator
the Drinfeld morphism cannot be treated as monoidal without its positive-monodromy defect

step_4_guards: a balanced twist without the ribbon dual law cannot authorize the spherical construction
the positive crossing in the ribbon loop cannot silently be replaced by its mirror
the dual twist theta_(X*) cannot silently be replaced by its inverse
sphericality is derived as a theorem rather than inserted as an independent field value
explicit_non_claims: No trace-cyclicity theorem has yet been derived from the canonical pivotal structure.
